title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 388  An Act Converting the Pag-Asa Barangay High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legaspi, Into a National High School, to Be Known as the Pag-Asa National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 388  An Act Converting the Pag-Asa Barangay High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legaspi, Into a National High School, to Be Known as the Pag-Asa National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Pag-Asa Barangay tại Barangay Rawis, Thành phố Legaspi thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Pag-Asa Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pag-Asa Barangay ในบารังไกย์ Rawis เมือง Legaspi เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pag-Asa แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Pag-Asa Barangay di Barangay Rawis, Kota Legaspi menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pag-Asa Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Pag-Asa Barangay di Barangay Rawis, Bandar Legaspi kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pag-Asa Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Pag-asa Barangay High School in Barangay Rawis, City of Legaspi, is converted into a
national high school, to be known as the Pag-asa National High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of
Education, Culture and Sports intended for new national high schools: Provided, That the local government
unit concerned shall continue to provide funding for its share in the cost of maintenance and operation of the
school. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the
annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 14, 1983
